selected_block.subtitle: separate WO-06 / WO-07

nodes.title: 6DOF plant
nodes.subtitle: shared simulation model
nodes.detail: The shared six-degree-of-freedom plant exists, but a future G12 complete configuration and controller validation are separate. This is not installed on current RP1.

nodes.title: Sensors
nodes.subtitle: noise, rate, bias, latency
nodes.detail: Preliminary sensor models exist. Calibrated G12 hardware and flight observations are not claimed.
nodes.signal: IMU m/s² + rad/s; baro AGL m

nodes.title: State estimate
nodes.subtitle: WO-06 deliverable
nodes.detail: An estimator must produce a usable state without relying on simulator truth attitude. No qualified estimator is supplied by this map.

nodes.title: Guidance / setpoint
nodes.subtitle: mission command
nodes.detail: Guidance and setpoints remain future control work. The external reference diagram’s predictive guidance and numerical target are not adopted.

nodes.title: PID → later RL
nodes.subtitle: separate WO-06 / WO-07
nodes.detail: PID gains are null in the source config; RL is a later separate work order. No controller execution, policy, tuning or performance is established.

nodes.title: Limits + abort
nodes.subtitle: safe-state boundary
nodes.detail: Command, position, rate, torque and abort limits require source and safety validation. A numeric output limit in a draft config is not a qualified physical actuator limit.

nodes.title: Servo / TVC
nodes.subtitle: preliminary model only
nodes.detail: The shared simulator has servo lag/delay/speed/deadband and two-axis thrust-vector mapping. Linkage, calibration, torque/current and moving inertia are unverified; current G80 gimbal is locked.
nodes.signal: modeled gimbal angle rad → body force/moment

nodes.title: Power + logging
nodes.subtitle: future hardware verification
nodes.detail: Power, pin assignments, firmware/HIL and log reliability require their own source and testing. Independent recovery must retain its separate power path.

nodes.title: Independent recovery
nodes.subtitle: separate safety path
nodes.detail: The RP1 source defines an independent recovery controller/battery; this is a separate concept from G12 ascent control and no G12 installation is inferred.
